title: love_of_life
author: london
summary: Abandoned by his companion Bill in the Canadian Barrens, a starving prospector battles hunger, injury, and a dying wolf in a desperate crawl toward a distant ship, ultimately surviving to be rescued by a whaler's crew.

issues.description: Two '* * * * *' section break markers appear in the body, but these are author-intended scene dividers rather than extraction errors.
